perturbative_regime.regime: B=0, conformal coupling only (A(φ) = exp(β_A φ/M_Pl))
perturbative_regime.theorem: Choquet-Bruhat, Geroch: Einstein-Klein-Gordon is strongly hyperbolic
perturbative_regime.classification: DERIVED — strongly hyperbolic in perturbative regime

gw170817_bound.disformal_perturbation: O(B × (∂φ)²) small where cone split is small
gw170817_bound.scalar_principal_perturbation: NOT bounded by GW170817 — Z_t, Z_s involve B·ρ and require the separate Z_t>0, Z_s>0 conditions
gw170817_bound.eigenvalue_shift: c_± = c(1 ± O(10⁻¹⁵)) in the propagation sector only
gw170817_bound.classification: DERIVED — propagation-sector cone split is a small regular perturbation; the matter-dependent principal operator is separately conditioned by Z_t>0, Z_s>0

strong_field_necessary_conditions.classification: DERIVED — necessary conditions identified; sufficient conditions require full principal symbol

regular_metric_elliptic_scalar.pathology: Z_t = 4.00 > 0 but Z_s = -1.00 < 0 → c_s² = -0.25 < 0 (imaginary sound speed, elliptic)
regular_metric_elliptic_scalar.conclusion: Metric nondegeneracy alone does not guarantee hyperbolicity: a regular matter metric coexists with an elliptic scalar sector.
regular_metric_elliptic_scalar.pathology_class: Coefficient sign (sound speed), NOT Ostrogradsky (EOM order)
regular_metric_elliptic_scalar.classification: DERIVED — counterexample shows metric nondegeneracy is insufficient

counterexample.pathology: Z_t = -4.00 < 0 (wrong signature) AND Z_s = -0.67 < 0 (imaginary sound speed if Z_t > 0)
counterexample.conclusion: Metric nondegeneracy alone does not guarantee hyperbolicity. Both Z_t and Z_s must be positive. Here both are negative, indicating a wrong-signature principal symbol.
counterexample.pathology_class: Coefficient sign (wrong signature), NOT Ostrogradsky (EOM order)
counterexample.classification: DERIVED — counterexample shows metric nondegeneracy is insufficient

scalar_gb.pathology: Characteristic degeneration on nontrivial backgrounds (weakly elliptic sector; Papallo & Reall 2017)
scalar_gb.fix: Independent characteristic analysis on each background; second-order EOM alone is insufficient

tep.pathology_class: Coefficient sign (sound speed), NOT EOM order

distinction_from_scalar_gb.distinction: Both TEP and Horndeski scalar-GB have 2nd-order EOM; neither can be exempted from characteristic analysis. The TEP pathology class (matter-dependent coefficient sign) is distinct from the scalar-GB background-dependent characteristic degeneration.
distinction_from_scalar_gb.classification: DERIVED — second-order EOM is not sufficient for hyperbolicity in either sector

summary.overall: Perturbative regime: strongly hyperbolic (derived). GW170817 bounds the propagation-sector cone split only; the matter-dependent principal operator is conditioned separately by Z_t>0, Z_s>0. Strong-field: necessary conditions identified, sufficient conditions require full principal symbol. Scalar-GB: 2nd-order EOM; characteristic degeneration requires separate analysis.
